results.description: Tajikistan’s President Emomali Rahmon met United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek on Monday, as concerns grow in Tajikistan over security along its border with Afghanistan. results.title: Congress delegation meets MP Governor, seeks prosecution sanction against Minister Vijay Shah
results.description: A Congress delegation led by MP Leader of Opposition Umang Singhar met Governor Mangubhai Patel, seeking prosecution sanction against Minister Vijay Shah over his controversial remarks about Colonel Sofiya Qureshi. The demand comes after the Governor approved the Cabinet’s decision denying sanction.

results.description: Telangana BJP president N Ramchander Rao was detained by police after being placed under house arrest to prevent him from visiting Nalgonda. He called the situation 'worst undemocratic' and blamed rising tensions with the ruling Congress party.

results.title: REVEALED: ODM Leader OBURU OGINGA hospitalised as family plans to fly him to the UK for specialized treatment – Pray for him!
results.description: Tuesday, September 01, 2026 - The Orange Democratic Movement (ODM) party leader, Dr. Oburu Odinga , has been hospitalised in Nairobi for the past three days. The Kenyan DAILY POST can authoritatively confirm. According to sources within ODM, the 82‐year‐old Siaya Senator was admitted on Sunday, August 30, with doctors citing severe fatigue and recommending rest. While the exact cause of his hospitalisation has not been disclosed, family members are reportedly considering flying him to the United Kingdom for specialised treatment. Insiders further revealed that access to Dr. Odinga has been restricted, with only close relatives permitted to visit. Political allies and fellow leaders have been turned away, underscoring the family’s tight control over his condition. Dr. Odinga was last seen in public on Saturday, August 29, playing golf, where he appeared in high spirits in images shared online. His sudden hospitalisation has therefore raised questions about when his health began to deteriorate. The development comes at a sensitive time for ODM, which is grappling with internal divisions. One faction, led by Senator Edwin Sifuna , opposes the party’s broad‐based arrangement with President William Ruto’s administration, while Dr. Odinga has been a vocal supporter of the cooperation. results.title: Delhi HC slams police for 'pick and choose' arrests in child case
results.description: The Delhi High Court slammed the police for 'selective arrests' in a child trafficking case, calling the probe 'highly appalling' as the infant remains unrecovered. The court dismissed an accused's bail plea, citing the gravity of the offence.
